scope: Application membership only, all 730 frozen ToMBench questions. Other five capability mappings, all other benchmarks, gold labels, prompts and model outcomes remain unchanged.

rubric.include: The requested answer directly predicts or selects an action, or judges an action or utterance in its social/mental-state context. Includes persuasion choices and communicative appropriateness judgments.
rubric.exclude: Answers attributing a belief, desire, intention, motive, or emotion; factual recall and utterance truth; observed-meaning recognition. Higher-order questions whose outer target asks what A thinks about B searching remain belief attribution, not direct behavioral output.
rubric.overlap: Preserve the original native-derived capability and add the application label when eligible.

review_method: Two separate agent-assisted question-target reviews followed by parent adjudication. Not independent human validation. No item-level model predictions, correctness or gold labels were used as classification evidence. Prior aggregate results were already known from the paper, so this is not a fully blinded study. Decisions were finalized before corrected scores were computed.

Xiaoxia and Xiaobai think Xiaonan likes to do this part of the task and want to give this part of the task to Xiaonan.
Because they think Xiaonan is good at this task and can complete it very well.
Xiaoxia and Xiaobai hope that Xiaonan does not sit silently, but also participates more in the meeting.
entries.rationale: Asks why an already supplied action or utterance occurred; the answer is a motive, intention, or interpretation rather than a prospective action.

Zhang Wei, out of kindness, does not want to hurt Li Hua's self-esteem. He knows that frankness may dampen Li Hua's enthusiasm and confidence.
Zhang Wei praises Li Hua because he wants to flatter Li Hua, so he deliberately pleases him.
